title: Pete's Birthday (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar warm baritone male vocal 104bpm upright bass brushed snare character portrait true story family birthday father celebration unhurried dry wit
lyrics:
[Intro - piano bar, warm and celebratory, just past midnight]
One sixteen in the morning.
Chas is awake.
He knows what day it is.
He always knows what day it is.

[Verse 1]
Pete's birthday today
Double exclamation marks
One sixteen AM
Chas was not going to let it pass
Without the announcement
The McIvor birthdays get announced
That's the rule
Chas keeps the calendar
In his head
And in his phone
And at one in the morning
He sends it
Pete's birthday today exclamation exclamation

[Verse 2]
Then Mum sends the photos
The birthday kind
Images omitted but she was there
And then she said:
Sorry bottom three photos are Pete
Gotta go to Specsavers
Haha
She sent Pete's photos
By accident
When she meant to send something else
And laughed at herself
In the WhatsApp
In the middle of the birthday
That is also the family

[Chorus]
Pete's birthday
Chas at one sixteen
Pete's birthday
Double exclamation marks
Pete's birthday
Mum with the wrong photos
Pete's birthday
Specsavers joke
Pete's birthday
The McIvor calendar
Never misses
Pete's birthday
Pete

[Bridge - spoken, dry and warm]
Charles Rodney McIvor.
Up at one sixteen AM.
Makes the announcement.
Pete's birthday today exclamation exclamation.
Pete is the middle one.
The quiet strong one.
The one the team runs through when things need to happen.
Chas never misses it.
Not once.
He was up at one sixteen to make sure Pete knew
his dad knew.
The double exclamation marks were both for Pete.

[Chorus reprise]
Pete's birthday
Chas remembers
Pete's birthday
One sixteen AM
Pete's birthday
Both exclamation marks
Are for you
Pete

[Outro - piano alone, settled]
Happy birthday Pete
From Dad
At one sixteen
He was awake
He always is
For the important ones
